from common import *

def main():
 save_source(__file__)
 import matplotlib
 matplotlib.use('Agg')
 import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
 from matplotlib.ticker import PercentFormatter
 import numpy as np
 from publish import path,official
 docs={n:read(path(n)) for n in ['h7continuous','h7q10','h15continuous','h15q10','h20continuous','h20q10','sum20continuous','sum20q10']}
 plt.rcParams.update({'font.size':10,'axes.spines.top':False,'axes.spines.right':False,'figure.facecolor':'white'})
 fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,3,figsize=(12,4.2),layout='constrained')
 for ax,r in zip(axes,['D','F','T']):
  for typ,color,label in [('continuous','#176a93','Continuous'),('q10','#d76c27','10 equal-count bins')]:
   vals=[official(docs[f'h{h}{typ}'])['head_regimes'][r]['3']['5']['net_ann'] for h in [7,15,20]]
   ax.plot([7,15,20],vals,marker='o',lw=2,color=color,label=label)
   for x,y in zip([7,15,20],vals):ax.annotate(f'{y:.1%}',(x,y),xytext=(0,8 if typ=='continuous' else -17),textcoords='offset points',ha='center',fontsize=8,color=color)
  ax.set_title(f'Style {r}'+(' (136 days in 2024)' if r=='F' else ''))
  ax.set_xticks([7,15,20]);ax.set_xlabel('Training horizon H');ax.yaxis.set_major_formatter(PercentFormatter(1));ax.grid(alpha=.18)
  ax.margins(y=.25)
 axes[0].set_ylabel('Top3 x H5 net annualized return')
 axes[0].legend(loc='best',fontsize=8)
 fig.suptitle('Same-source horizon comparison | five-seed z-score ensemble',fontsize=13)
 for ext in ['png','svg']:fig.savefig(BASE/'reports'/f'horizon-style.{ext}',dpi=180)
 plt.close(fig)
 names=['h20continuous','h20q10','sum20continuous','sum20q10']
 fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,3,figsize=(12,4.2),layout='constrained')
 for ax,(key,title) in zip(axes,[('net_ann','Net annualized return'),('net_ann_vol','HAC annualized volatility'),('net_sharpe','Net Sharpe')]):
  vals=[official(docs[n])['head']['3']['5'][key] for n in names]
  ax.bar(np.arange(4),vals,color=['#176a93','#65a2bd','#d76c27','#efb27b'],width=.65)
  for i,v in enumerate(vals):ax.text(i,v,f'{v:.2%}' if key!='net_sharpe' else f'{v:.3f}',ha='center',va='bottom',fontsize=9)
  ax.set_xticks(np.arange(4),['H20\ncontinuous','H20\n10 bins','Sum20\ncontinuous','Sum20\n10 bins']);ax.set_title(title);ax.set_ylim(0,max(vals)*1.20);ax.grid(axis='y',alpha=.18)
  if key!='net_sharpe':ax.yaxis.set_major_formatter(PercentFormatter(1))
 fig.suptitle('Raw cumulative-return sum vs terminal H20 | same ordered training sample',fontsize=13)
 for ext in ['png','svg']:fig.savefig(BASE/'reports'/f'path-sum-comparison.{ext}',dpi=180)
 plt.close(fig)
 print('Saved two scientific figures (PNG/SVG).',flush=True)

if __name__=='__main__':main()
